notes: WebAssembly scrypt (rust-crypto). hash() is given logN 12, r 8, p 1 and a 32-byte key in PHC format; the salt is the package's own random 32 bytes.
details: hash() with logN 12 instead of its default 17, PHC output format, dklen 32. verify() re-derives the hash from the parameters stored in the string and compares in constant time.
